summary.plain: Two movable particle spectrometers that could be swung to different angles around the collision point to catch charged particles over a wide range of directions and momenta.
summary.technical: BRAHMS: forward and mid-rapidity magnetic spectrometer arms with particle identification, movable in angle, plus global multiplicity and centrality detectors; specifications not recorded (detector paper unavailable as text).

technology.quote: The BRAHMS experiment was designed to measure charged hadrons over a wide range of rapidity and transverse momentum
technology.value: Movable magnetic spectrometers measuring identified charged hadrons over a wide range of rapidity and transverse momentum
